plan.name: Vegan Muscle Gain - 12 Week Upper/Lower + Low-Intensity Cardio (150g Plant Protein Daily)

goals.name: Muscle gain with 150g plant protein daily
Post-workout meal 1: Tofu scramble wrap - 200g extra-firm tofu, black beans, spinach, whole-wheat tortilla (~40g protein)
Post-workout meal 2: Seitan and edamame stir-fry with jasmine rice and broccoli (~45g protein)
Post-workout meal 3: Shake - 2 scoops pea or soy protein, soy milk, oats, banana, peanut butter (~45g protein)
Post-workout meal 4: Tempeh and lentil quinoa bowl with roasted sweet potato and tahini (~40g protein)
Post-workout meal 5: Red lentil pasta with soy mince bolognese and nutritional yeast (~45g protein)
Post-workout meal 6: High-protein soy yogurt with pea protein, hemp seeds, berries, granola (~35g protein)
Protein powder choice: soy isolate or a pea plus rice blend (complete amino acid profile), 20-25g protein and 2g+ leucine per scoop
Protein powder screening: certified vegan label, third-party tested (Informed Sport or NSF Certified for Sport), avoid added vitamin D3 from lanolin unless lichen-sourced
Protein powder dosing: 1-2 scoops daily (25-50g protein) to close the gap to 150g, one serving within 2 hours post-training
Sunday cheat meal: one relaxed meal per week on the rest day, fully vegan (e.g. vegan pizza with plant cheese, seitan burger and fries, loaded bean burrito, dairy-free dessert)
Cheat meal guardrails: one meal not a full day, still hit 150g protein that day, check labels for hidden dairy, egg, honey, gelatin, whey, casein, and carmine
Cheat meal protein boost: pair the meal with a seitan or soy-based main or add a shake earlier in the day to stay on target
Breakfast 1: Protein oats - 60g oats cooked in 300ml soy milk, 1 scoop pea or soy protein stirred in, 2 tbsp hemp seeds, berries (~45g protein)
Breakfast 2: Tofu scramble - 250g extra-firm tofu with turmeric and nutritional yeast, 2 slices seeded wholegrain toast, sauteed spinach (~40g protein)
Breakfast 3: Chickpea flour omelette with vegan sausage or smoked tempeh, peppers and onion (~35g protein)
Breakfast 4: Overnight soy yogurt bowl - 250g high-protein soy yogurt, 1 scoop protein powder, chia seeds, peanut butter, banana (~40g protein)
Breakfast tip: aim for 35-45g protein at breakfast so the remaining meals and shakes comfortably reach 150g; prefer soy milk over oat or almond milk (~7-8g vs ~1g protein per cup)
Phase 3 intensification: heavier compound loading (down to 3-5 reps), RPE 9 on compounds, RPE 9-10 on isolation work, extra sets, longer rest on main lifts; week 12 deload preserved

Phase 3 guardrails: RPE 10 only on isolation and machine work, never on squat, deadlift, bench, or overhead press; keep 1 rep in reserve on barbell compounds; use a spotter or safety arms on heavy bench and squat
Phase 3 recovery: higher training stress needs a slight calorie surplus, 150g protein every day, 7-9h sleep; drop one set per exercise if performance stalls for two sessions
